value.rationale: An intrinsic arithmetic stratification on a natural entire genus-three curve family becomes three transverse nonordinary components with a unique triple superspecial intersection. The result gives exact point-count polynomials for every finite extension and each Newton polygon, not arbitrary small tables or merely an abstract decomposition. It helps quantify the distribution and incidence of partial ordinarity in a classical parameter space; limitations regarding marked equations are explicit.
